entities.name: Battle of Kjeldor
entities.description: Four-night battle between the undead hordes of Haakon of Tresserhorn and the defenders of Kjeldor under King Darien.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: The city whose northern fields the defenders hold against Stromgald's army.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor who fights at the forefront and finally kills Haakon.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: The towering Stromgald general in black armor who leads the undead army and is finally killed by Darien.

entities.name: Stromgald
entities.description: The army, partly undead, that attacks Kjeldor.

entities.name: Kjeldor army
entities.description: The defenders led by the narrator, with Field Marshals and a Jotun squad.

entities.name: Jotun squad
entities.description: A specialized unit of giants deployed by the narrator after the second night.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent on which the narrator says his men are the mightiest army.

events.summary: The first Stromgald attack comes after three days of waiting; the defenders cut down the vanguard and hold the line, though some enemies get back up.
events.quote: Our line held, however, and when the first wave reached us, they were stopped cold.

events.summary: The second night's two-part attack, with knights breaking through, is slowed by the defenders' placement and closed in on by reinforcements.
events.quote: As the knights broke through, we closed ranks behind them.

events.summary: The narrator deploys the Jotun squad of giants who had seen what Stromgald does to a land.
events.quote: It was at this time that I decided to deploy our Jötun squad .

events.summary: On the third night the dead from both sides keep rising and fighting; a fallen Jotun is seen again as a Stromgald zombie, and the defenders grow stronger, ending with less than half their numbers.
events.quote: By the time the fighting was finally over, we had less than half of our original numbers.

events.summary: On the fourth night only Haakon comes forward; Darien goes out to face him and the two leaders fight for hours.
events.quote: The two leaders of the armies fought for hours.

events.summary: The defenders realize the Stromgald army is watching from beyond and, understanding Darien would die for them, swarm out and charge.
events.quote: As one, we swarmed out of our emplacements and charged.

events.summary: Slowed by the soldiers' waves, Haakon is finished off by Darien, and his army slinks away; Kjeldor wins.
events.quote: Darien, who looked a lot more bloodied up close, was able to finish him off.

events.summary: As the defenders regroup, the narrator sees black smoke on the horizon and hears a faint alien sound.
events.quote: I saw lines of thick black smoke rising into the dawn sky.

relations.note: Finished off the Stromgald general after the soldiers slowed him.
relations.quote: was able to finish him off
All that we saw was Haakon , the Stromgald general

relations.note: King at the forefront of the defenders.
relations.quote: with King Darien himself at the forefront
a rampaging horde of Stromgald's meanest, most vicious fighters
